title: My Generation
studio_context: IBC, London, 12 April to 12 November 1965; released 3 December 1965 (in the US as The Who Sings My Generation, Decca, April 1966). Moon on a Ludwig, Premier from late 1965.

drum_performances.name: Keith Moon
drum_performances.why_it_matters: The single My Generation (stops for Daltrey's vocal, the ride in eighths, eighth-note-triplet rolls on the snare and floor tom to the coda) and The Kids Are Alright (Motown's snare on every beat, its break 'laden with manic drum rolls').

notable_moments.description: My Generation: he stops and starts 'along with the pauses for Daltrey's lead vocals'.
My Generation's last choruses and coda: a crash, then a bar of snare triplets falling to the floor tom, by turns.
